entries_to_add.question: In WWOX-deficient versus isogenic corrected human neural cells that include microglia or CNS-macrophage-like cells, are NRF2 target activity, ROS and IL-6/IL-1beta protein different, and does NFE2L2-dependent activation (KEAP1 knockdown, omaveloxolone, monomethyl fumarate) change viability, lipid peroxidation, network activity or cytokine protein more in knockout than in corrected cells?
entries_to_add.data: Step 0: nuclear NRF2 and KEAP1 protein, NQO1 activity, NQO1/HMOX1/GCLM/SRXN1 transcripts, ROS reporter at baseline and after an oxidative challenge, IL-6 and IL-1beta protein after LPS with or without ATP. Step 1: the activation arms above and NFE2L2 knockdown, both genotypes, with MEA network activity and SOX2/NEUN fractions. Guards: GFAP/IBA1 counts are held-out endpoints; the six IT7 readout genes cannot decide.
entries_to_add.would_change: If neither ROS nor NRF2 tone nor cytokine protein differs and activation changes nothing: the axis moves to inert and the card is closed. If ROS is raised and activation corrects it in knockout cells more than in corrected cells (NFE2L2-dependent): arm R advances to a second model; omaveloxolone paediatric limits then become the development question.
entries_to_add.feasibility: Wet-lab with isogenic human neural cells and a microglia source; two commercial research compounds (availability UNVERIFIED); step 0 is a one-to-two-week assay set; whether a laboratory with the isogenic lines will run it: not known.
entries_to_add.summary_it: Capire se nelle cellule neurali carenti di WWOX ci sono ROS, tono di NRF2 o citochine (proteina) alterati, e se attivare NRF2 cambia vitalità o attività di rete in modo dipendente da NRF2.
entries_to_add.feasibility_it: Laboratorio con linee neurali isogeniche e una fonte di microglia; non noto.

entries_to_modify.note: If a work-order entry cites 'Il6 and Tnf-a both significant', correct to 'Il6 significant, Tnf-a not' (needs patch op 1).
